versions.changelog:
- 新增 shell.sh 脚本，实现所有操作统一通过脚本调用，并自动处理 root 权限切换与日志记录。
- 所有文档命令示例切换为 shell.sh 统一调用方式，提升易用性和可维护性。
- 文档增加日志调试说明，每次命令调用生成日志文件便于排错。
- 原有手动 su 切换方式由脚本自动化，降低使用门槛。

openclaw-android 1.0.0 – First release

- Initial version introducing remote control of Android devices via root commands.
- Supports listing, opening, and closing apps; app interaction (tap, swipe, input text); and taking screenshots.
- All commands executed internally on the device after switching to root.
- Suitable for automation, remote control, and app management scenarios.
